ASTRA CARE – Astronaut Health Monitoring & Emergency Response System
ASTRA CARE is a mobile application designed to monitor and support astronauts’ physical and mental health during space missions. It provides personalized health profiles, health monitoring, AI-assisted assessment, and emergency response features.
The app allows astronauts to report symptoms, receive preliminary medical guidance, and connect with healthcare professionals when necessary. Its emergency feature enables quick access to assistance without requiring a completed personal profile.
By integrating health monitoring, AI-assisted support, and medical communication, ASTRA CARE aims to enhance astronaut safety, enable timely medical intervention, and promote well-being throughout space exploration.
details:
ASTRA CARE – Astronaut Health Monitoring & Emergency Response System

ASTRA CARE is an integrated healthcare application designed to monitor and support astronauts’ physical and mental health throughout space missions. It provides personalized astronaut profiles containing essential medical information and health history, alongside health monitoring features that track vital signs such as heart rate, blood oxygen levels, blood pressure, and body temperature. The application also includes AI-assisted medical assessment to analyze reported symptoms, identify potential health risks, and provide initial guidance. One of its key features is an emergency response system with an easily accessible emergency button, allowing astronauts to request medical assistance quickly without having to complete their profiles first. We also incorporated voice-based interaction to make the application easier to use in critical situations, especially when astronauts are exhausted, sleepy, stressed, or unable to operate the screen manually. Through voice commands, they can report symptoms, request assistance, and receive audio instructions and alerts. Additionally, ASTRA CARE supports doctor communication, mental health monitoring, sleep and fatigue tracking, and dedicated interfaces for both astronauts and medical officers. Ultimately, our goal is to provide astronauts with an accessible digital medical companion that helps them manage their health, respond to emergencies, and receive medical support even in the challenging environment of space.
